asset.text: Method-level declarative sub-MILP repair for the registered federated cohort-selection problem only. Release violation variables and direct neighbors, keep every other binary decision fixed, solve the complete public formulation, and accept only a fully rechecked non-regressing candidate. Costs are observed means over the three real predeclared single-chain treatment runs; they are not a promised runtime or cross-task estimate.
